label: SB-19 RTT holdouts: emulated 1 ms and 10 ms round-trip profiles per RPC shape class (contract section 3.6)
methodology: server cells only: each server peer under test driven by the fixed native open-loop Poisson generator through rpc-bench's bench-only loopback TCP proxy (--latency-rtt-ms adds half the RTT per direction). Before EACH measured repeat the runner records the configured RTT setting and verifies the emulation with a measured ping probe (short constant-rate unary-empty load through the same proxy path); a repeat whose measured p50 does not evidence the configured delay is invalid, never silently accepted. One discarded warmup probe per cell, then 3 measured repeats. Validation stage: pass means ran + reconciled + emulation verified + no generator-capped repeat (SB-11 client-CPU signal or rejections); no leadership threshold here. Cell order is frozen: peers in file order x cells in file order.
claim_note: loopback-proxy RTT is bench-only emulation: authoritative RTT cells need client and server on separate hosts over a real network with tc netem (contract 3.6, 8). These cells prove harness wiring and window/pipelining behavior, not claim numbers.

cells.note: server-streaming class, 10 ms profile; bidi-under-RTT stays future work until pipelined bidi is drivable

params.rtt_mechanism: rpc-bench loopback TCP proxy via --latency-rtt-ms (RTT/2 added per direction); internal to each load process
